title: fix validation: Only set tool_choice `auto` if at least one tool is provided
body:
Passing 

```
{
...
"tools": null
}
```

without "tool_choice" key causes a validation failure because the code sets "tool_choice" to "auto" on its own and then fails because it finds "tools" as None.
This change fixes the validation so that "tool_choice" is only set if at least one tool is provided
head: eae161c33f47a0b760701769f56fc249563f8ed0
